meta.name: spec-workflow-orchestrator
meta.description: Orchestrate comprehensive planning phase from ideation to development-ready specifications using 3 specialized agents (Full workflow documentation at docs/workflows/planning-workflow.md)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将创意转化为开发就绪的规格文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从零开始规划产品功能并产出详细规格说明。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan product features from scratch and produce detailed specs.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成从想法到开发规格的规划阶段，依次调用三个专业代理：需求分析、架构设计、任务分解，并生成文档。
howto.when: 当你提出“规划[应用]”、“设计[系统]”、“制定[功能]需求”或“准备开发”等请求时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个任务管理应用。
say.note: 启动完整规划流程，生成需求、架构和任务分解文档。

say.text: 为我的电商网站设计系统架构。
say.note: 触发架构设计代理，输出架构文档和决策记录。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the planning phase from idea to dev-ready specs, sequentially invoking three specialized agents: requirements analysis, architecture design, and task breakdown, producing documentation.
howto.when_en: Auto-invoked when you request planning, architecture, requirements, or pre-development tasks like 'Plan [app]', 'Design [system]', 'Requirements for [project]'.

say_en.text: Plan a task management app for me.
Design system architecture for my e-commerce site.
say_en.note: Triggers architecture agent, outputs architecture doc and decision records.
